import argparse
import yaml
from fate_flow.pipeline import Pipeline
from fate_flow.pipeline.components.federated import (
    Reader,
    DataTransform,
    Intersection,
    FeatureScale,
    HeteroFeatureBinning,
    DataStatistics,
    Pearson,
    OneHotEncoder,
    HeteroFeatureSelection,
    HeteroLR,
    Evaluation
)
from fate_flow.pipeline.interface import Data

# Default config path
DEFAULT_CONFIG = "default_config.yaml"

def load_config(config_path):
    with open(config_path, "r") as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=str, default=DEFAULT_CONFIG, help="Path to config file")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = load_config(args.config)

    guest = config["role"]["guest"][0]
    host = config["role"]["host"][0]
    arbiter = config["role"]["arbiter"][0]

    # Feature binning parameters
    feature_binning_param = {
        "method": "quantile",
        "bin_num": 10,
        "adjustment_factor": 0.5,
        "local_only": False
    }

    # Feature selection parameters
    feature_selection_param = {
        "select_col_indexes": -1,
        "select_names": [],
        "filter_methods": ["iv_filter", "variance_filter"],
        "iv_param": {"threshold": 0.1},
        "variance_param": {"threshold": 1e-5}
    }

    # Logistic regression parameters
    lr_param = {
        "penalty": "L2",
        "optimizer": "sgd",
        "max_iter": 10,
        "learning_rate": 0.15,
        "batch_size": -1,
        "init_param": {"init_method": "random_uniform"},
        "early_stop": "diff",
        "tol": 1e-4
    }

    # Reader
    reader_0 = Reader(name="reader_0")
    reader_0.get_party_instance(role="guest", party_id=guest).component_param(
        table=config["data"]["guest"]
    )
    reader_0.get_party_instance(role="host", party_id=host).component_param(
        table=config["data"]["host"]
    )

    # DataTransform
    data_transform_0 = DataTransform(name="data_transform_0", with_label=True, output_format="dense")
    data_transform_0.get_party_instance(role="guest", party_id=guest).component_param(
        with_label=True, output_format="dense"
    )
    data_transform_0.get_party_instance(role="host", party_id=host).component_param(
        with_label=False
    )

    # Intersection
    intersection_0 = Intersection(name="intersection_0")

    # FeatureScale
    feature_scale_0 = FeatureScale(name="feature_scale_0", method="min_max")
    feature_scale_0.get_party_instance(role="guest", party_id=guest)
    feature_scale_0.get_party_instance(role="host", party_id=host)

    # FeatureBinning
    feature_binning_0 = HeteroFeatureBinning(
        name="feature_binning_0",
        method=feature_binning_param["method"],
        bin_num=feature_binning_param["bin_num"],
        adjustment_factor=feature_binning_param["adjustment_factor"],
        local_only=feature_binning_param["local_only"]
    )

    # DataStatistics
    data_statistics_0 = DataStatistics(name="data_statistics_0")

    # Pearson Correlation
    pearson_0 = Pearson(name="pearson_0")

    # OneHotEncoder
    one_hot_encoder_0 = OneHotEncoder(name="one_hot_encoder_0")

    # FeatureSelection
    feature_selection_0 = HeteroFeatureSelection(
        name="feature_selection_0",
        select_col_indexes=feature_selection_param["select_col_indexes"],
        select_names=feature_selection_param["select_names"],
        filter_methods=feature_selection_param["filter_methods"],
        iv_param=feature_selection_param["iv_param"],
        variance_param=feature_selection_param["variance_param"]
    )

    # Logistic Regression
    hetero_lr_0 = HeteroLR(
        name="hetero_lr_0",
        penalty=lr_param["penalty"],
        optimizer=lr_param["optimizer"],
        max_iter=lr_param["max_iter"],
        learning_rate=lr_param["learning_rate"],
        batch_size=lr_param["batch_size"],
        init_param=lr_param["init_param"],
        early_stop=lr_param["early_stop"],
        tol=lr_param["tol"]
    )

    # Evaluation
    evaluation_0 = Evaluation(name="evaluation_0", eval_type="binary")

    # Build pipeline
    pipeline = Pipeline()
    pipeline.set_roles(guest=guest, host=host, arbiter=arbiter)
    pipeline.add_component(reader_0)
    pipeline.add_component(data_transform_0, data=Data(data=reader_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(intersection_0, data=Data(data=data_transform_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(feature_scale_0, data=Data(data=intersection_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(feature_binning_0, data=Data(data=feature_scale_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(data_statistics_0, data=Data(data=feature_binning_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(pearson_0, data=Data(data=feature_binning_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(one_hot_encoder_0, data=Data(data=feature_binning_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(feature_selection_0, data=Data(data=one_hot_encoder_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(hetero_lr_0, data=Data(train_data=feature_selection_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(evaluation_0, data=Data(data=hetero_lr_0.output.data))

    pipeline.compile()
    pipeline.fit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
